newsitem.title: USA: IPO FILING-Peptor files for 2 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: IPO FILING-Peptor files for 2 mln shares.

text.p: Peptor Ltd filed Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission an initial public offering of up to two million ordinary shares which it expects to sell between $14 and $16 each.
Underwriters for the offering, Credit Suisse First Boston and VOlpe Brown Whelan & Co, have an over-allotment option of up to 300,000 shares.
The Tel Aviv drug manufacturer said proceeds from the sale, an estimated $26 million, will be used to fund research, equipment acquisitions and other general corporate needs.
After the offering, the company will have 7,693,190 ordinary shares outstanding.
For the three months ended Marcy 31, the company reported a net loss of $899,000, or 16 cents a share.
